mappings.rationale: Reexecutes missed full-run failures in isolation and partitions confirmed omissions from unstable failures; a local result grants no qualification.

Applies unique bounded mutations in temporary copies, compares candidate/full failures, suspends on confirmed omissions and accounts for observed phases without claiming the exploratory 30 percent target or broad adoption.
Rejects nonnumeric, boolean, negative and nonfinite capture, selection and execution costs; missing comparable measurements remain unknown rather than presumed savings.
Runs each requested comparison phase against the mutant copy and records validated command and wall costs for actual calls, including confirmation rather than inferred executions.
Routes isolated missed-test reexecution through the confirmation phase, preserving the mutant directory and distinguishing repeatable omission from instability.
Excludes only the existing copy-time cache, Git, environment and target directories while retaining ordinary fixture files and leaving original files and governed configuration unchanged.
Computes conservative reverse import closures for direct, transitive, lazy, script and code-string dependencies; unavailable analyzers fall back without granting execution authority.
Enumerates Python files under explicit source/test folders, providing the bounded fixture inventory used for conservative import candidates.
Includes project package prefixes of imported names so package initialization remains part of conservative AST reachability.
Extracts absolute/relative imports and module names inside strings, including code passed to Python and conservative lazy package members.
Parses cached AST dependencies and expands an unparsable file to all project modules rather than silently losing candidates.
Combines analyzer imports with package initialization, lazy expansion, script paths and textual imports; AST remains the fallback engine.
Returns no graph on missing Ruff, timeout, unsuccessful exit or invalid JSON/shape, activating the tested conservative AST fallback.
An explicitly configured nonexistent core resolves to None, preserving fallback rather than assuming native impact proof.
Returns None without a usable core so recommendation uses static policy; native execution coverage remains a separately reported conditional test.
Detects package __getattr__ and treats missing or undecodable package text conservatively as lazy; ordinary readable packages do not require that expansion.
Separates path and numeric line for recommendation reachability; noncanonical and nonpositive changes remain subject to explicit applicability fallback.
Reports structural invalidations for capture, configuration, environment, mandatory and impact gaps; even CANDIDATE retains false execution_authorized and supports_success.
Refuses absolute, traversing and noncanonical relative paths before structural advice; invalid paths produce FALLBACK rather than candidate authority.
Separates locally observed candidates, static impact, mandatory tests and unproven blocks; stale/config/environment/data gaps and untrusted EXTERNALLY_VERIFIED strings retain full-suite fallback.

Requires callable independent verification, current owner observations and exact scope digest, target hashes and coverage before scoped C5 composition; artifact/target changes invalidate it and immediate rechecking remains the executor's responsibility.
Labels static references and unproven changes while returning FULL_SUITE even for complete:true; mandatory tests remain in the command and no coverage attestation is inferred.
Rejects empty/non-string and control-containing scope text, including DEL in nodeids, before canonical binding.
Normalizes relative scope paths while rejecting traversal and absolute/drive paths; fingerprint and nodeid callers additionally require canonical spelling.
Requires positive decimal source lines and normalized relative paths, rejecting missing, nonnumeric and nonpositive line specifications.
Requires canonical pytest path/name identities and refuses controls, traversal, missing names and noncanonical path prefixes before inventory membership checks.
Recursively rejects Python-only capture values and non-string object keys before canonical serialization also refuses NaN/infinity.

Binds canonical capture, current fingerprints, changed lines, selected and mandatory inventories; rejects unlisted/add/remove changes, invalid fingerprints, unknown nodeids and out-of-range target lines.

Returns deterministic normalized scope without mutating inputs; canonical digest changes with target, capture, selection or mandatory and malformed input fails closed as ValueError, never execution authority.
Clears accumulated observation data and preserves the first truncation reason; bounded synthetic overflow receipts remain unusable and retain pytest exit status.
Bounds UTF-8 text and estimated serialized storage, producing explicit TEXT_LIMIT or BYTE_LIMIT rather than a usable clipped capture.
Records collected nodeids only while reporting is enabled and bounds their inventory; the small real run checks inventory against execution keys.
Records failed nodeids and setup/call/teardown durations in a tiny real failing fixture; measurements are local observations, not savings or execution attestation.
Installs per-test tracing and restores the prior trace callback even after pair overflow; the bounded real fixture observes Python lines without claiming transitive closure.
Collects unique Python path/line observations beneath the root and stops on pair overflow; does not claim threads, subprocesses or native coverage.
Writes a bounded observation with explicit completion flags and original exit status; missing reporting or an unwritable destination cannot manufacture success evidence.
Serializes nodeids, executed blocks, failures, timings, counters and completion state; independently decoded bounded and real-run receipts check these observation fields.
Computes exact byte SHA-256 for local capture identity; independent hashlib expectations check a known payload and capture digest fields without conferring authority.
Fingerprints sorted Python/config/requirements files while excluding observation caches and Git data; changed fingerprints retain conservative recommendation fallback.
Records exact Python, executable, platform, pytest and pytest environment values, retaining None when pytest metadata is absent and fallback on environment mismatch.
Preserves short selections and writes one argument per line to a pytest argfile above 30000 command-line characters; command construction grants no execution permission.

Rejects explicit incomplete or truncated observations even with nonempty tests, plus missing inventory, collection errors and foreign origin; preserves usable legacy receipts and local elapsed/output accounting.
Persists fingerprints, config/environment hashes and scan/suite/capture costs with local unattested coverage and UNKNOWN closure; synthetic accounting does not demonstrate operational savings.
Rejects noncanonical, traversing, Windows and control-character paths before exact owner-qualified mapping resolution.
Selects only explicit JSON files; diagnoses missing, excluded, duplicate, unsafe and oversized selections while enforcing the 16-file bound.
Bounds source and mapping bytes on disk and in memory, rejects non-bytes inputs, and refuses filesystem escape or symlink sources before source-hash validation.
Rejects duplicate JSON keys including nested objects instead of silently replacing source-qualified mapping fields.
Returns complete JSON plus LF within the UTF-8 byte budget or BUDGET_REQUIRED with the canonical full-packet digest, without clipping mandatory identity or criteria.
Separately classifies static references, verifies declarations, executed coverage and unknown relations; classification alone grants no attestation.
Publishes decomposed CamelCase, snake_case and accent-normalized tokens used by persistent postings without claiming translation or semantic identity.
Quotes normalized literal tokens and distinguishes natural-language OR from identifier AND expressions, including empty terms.
Bounds visited nodes during published SPEC/ADR expansion and reports intent_node_limit rather than admitting additional nodes; bounded retrieval preserves declared edge and source provenance.
ValueError subtype raised for an invalid explicit owner selection, which ground --read-bodies reports as a failure before any acquisition.

Parses the explicit REPOSITORY=PATH owner checkouts that ground --read-bodies acquires bodies from, resolving relative paths against the caller base; rejects absent components and normalized duplicate owner names.
Extracts supported Python model forms from AST while ignoring ordinary classes and never executing module effects.
Normalizes backslash source paths and initializes per-visitor contract collections independently.
Normalizes and deduplicates model docstring tags, including absent and criterion-free annotations.
Recognizes BaseModel/Schema and supported simple, qualified and called dataclass decorators; preserves local annotated types, defaults, lines and own tags.

Preserves property types/descriptions, required membership, deduplicated tags, relative identity and bounded raw text; reports parse, read, encoding and escape errors.

Discovers explicit files/directories across .sql/.ddl/.json/.py, honors excluded components, ignores other suffixes and aggregates malformed JSON, AST, encoding and escaping search errors.
Reads strict UTF-8 and parses local model AST without executing fixture effects; reports syntax, read, encoding and path escape failures.
Independent schema record: asdict checks all contract field defaults and isolated field/tag lists, complemented by exact SQL, JSON and Python extracted record assertions.
Independent schema record: asdict checks name/type/required/description defaults, with cross-format field equality and positive/negative required, type and description mutations.
Coordinates AST-only route/tool extraction with lexical identities; forbidden module effect is never executed.
Initializes independent collections, normalized paths, lexical identities and local handler references; tree-less fallback retains normalized identity.

Normalizes explicit spec/criterion tags, removes repeated tags and preserves empty or criterion-free annotations.

Honors explicit file/directory searches and excluded path components, aggregating AST/UTF-8/security errors with valid results.
Reads strict UTF-8 and parses AST without executing a forbidden top-level effect; reports invalid syntax/encoding and root escape.
